comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No code defects found; one sentence in the PR description misstates how the regular menu appends rows.

### The regular menu does not append an array

The description says the batching matches what "the regular menu already does", and the linked evidence README says the regular menu "already appends an array". `rebuildDisplay()` still appends one row at a time (`shell/plugins/menu/Menu.qml` line 676 at this head), so this PR adds the only array append in the file. **Impact:** runtime behaviour is unaffected, but the text presents the change as following an existing pattern and hides that the regular menu keeps the per-row cost.

**Suggested change:** Drop that clause from the description and README, or apply the same `displayModel.append(rows)` at line 676 (the regular-menu path was not tested).

<details><summary>Reproducer (at d7f3bff7)</summary>

Run in any clone of omacom/omarchy:

```bash
git fetch origin pull/13390/head
git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD        # d7f3bff7c7b0f0d62e3088d627acfa16ec72f407
grep -n "displayModel.append" shell/plugins/menu/Menu.qml
grep -n "^  function rebuild" shell/plugins/menu/Menu.qml
```

Actual output at d7f3bff7:

```
595:    if (rows.length) displayModel.append(rows)
676:    for (var k = 0; k < rows.length; k++) displayModel.append(rows[k])
246:  function rebuildItemsFromSources() {
553:  function rebuildDmenuDisplay() {
607:  function rebuildDisplay() {
```

Line 676 is inside `rebuildDisplay()` (the regular menu, lines 607 to 684). It collects rows into an array but still calls `displayModel.append` once per row. The same per-row loop is at line 674 of the merge-base (c5b4db77) and line 677 of the current `quattro` tip (b421b1b4). Line 595 (this PR) is the only array append in `Menu.qml`.
</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Verified:**
- In Qt 6.11.2, `ListModel.append` with an array emits one insert and one `countChanged`, and adds each element through the same path as a single-object append, so roles and types are created identically. An empty array emits nothing.
- A synthetic QtQml harness ran the extracted base and head `rebuildDmenuDisplay()` over 75 cases (empty, no-match and whitespace filters, Unicode, duplicate labels, input mode, out-of-range selection). Rows, all 16 roles and their types, count, selection, `layoutSerial` and the deferred `revealCursor` matched in every case. Two deliberately broken variants were detected.
- For a fresh 236-row rebuild in that harness, `visibleRowsHeight` evaluations fell from 237 to 2, and rows walked from 28,202 to 472.
- The focused menu, keybindings-menu, menu-guards and menu-plugin tests (the 166 checks cited) pass at head with output identical to the merge-base, and also pass with head merged into `quattro`.
- No textual conflicts with the other recent open PRs that touch `Menu.qml` (#13642, #13469, #13246, #13225, #13193, #13191); #13391 is stacked on this commit.

**Optional test improvement:** no existing test covers this path. A copy of the head with line 595 changed to `if (rows.length) void rows`, which leaves the selector with no rows, still passes the eight focused menu test files (including the 121 `menu-test.sh` checks) with output identical to the head. This check, added inside `menu-test.sh`'s Node block (which defines `menuQml`), fails on that mutant and at the merge-base and passes at head. It guards only the text shape, not runtime behaviour:

```js
const body = menuQml.match(/function rebuildDmenuDisplay\(\) \{([\s\S]*?)\n  \}/)[1]
assert(
  /rows\.push\(\{/.test(body)
    && /displayModel\.append\(rows\)/.test(body)
    && !/displayModel\.append\(\{/.test(body),
  'menu select mode appends its filtered rows to the model in one batch'
)
```
</details>
